verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm 'Copilot connectors are currently available on Copilot.com and on Copilot Mobile (iOS and Android)', establishing official iOS/Android apps exist and support core connector/chat features. However, there's no first-party or hands-on evidence detailing mobile-specific feature parity (e.g., Word/Excel/PowerPoint copilots, Vision, voice mode) on the mobile apps, and community feedback focuses only on desktop/Office integration quality, not mobile experience. Missing for 10: mobile-specific feature parity details, hands-on mobile app reviews, and confirmation of full functionality (Vision, Voice, connectors) actually working within the mobile app UI.
